mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Set, list or remove debugger breakpoints and watchpoints.

description: [read-only] Debugger breakpoints and watchpoints: each call sends one SAP request, the operation's, and answers what SAP answered. kind abap: setBreakpoints sets the breakpoint set of this debugging identity to breakpoints and answers each row SAP placed or refused; syncBreakpoints rewrites the full set (sync_scope full) or the part of the objects in sync_objects (sync_scope partial); deleteBreakpoint deletes breakpoint_id; createWatchpoint, listWatchpoints and deleteWatchpoint work on the attached debuggee. In user mode the breakpoints catch every request of the request user; the set is one per SAP user and request user, shared by every IDE of that user, and each change rewrites it as a whole. kind amdp: syncBreakpoints rewrites the breakpoints of the running AMDP session and answers the request id; SAP confirms them in a SYNC_BREAKPOINTS event. The answer carries state_handle, and for abap the identity in force. Runs outside batch mode.

breakpoint_id.description: abap deleteBreakpoint: the id SAP gave the breakpoint.

breakpoints.description: setBreakpoints and syncBreakpoints: abap a line, an exception class, an ABAP statement or a message, a line breakpoint may carry a condition; amdp object_name (the class) and line of each, an empty list clears them.

condition.description: A line breakpoint only: stops only when this ABAP condition holds.

exception_class.description: Stops where an exception of this class is raised.

include.description: For a class: definitions, implementations, macros or testclasses; the main source when omitted.

line.description: For a line: the line in the object source.

message.description: Stops where this message is sent: message class, number, type.

object_name.description: For a line: the object holding it.

object_type.description: For a line: CLAS, PROG, INCL or FUNC.

parent_name.description: For a function module: its function group.

statement.description: Stops at every ABAP statement of this keyword.

condition.description: abap createWatchpoint: the ABAP condition the watchpoint stops on.

debugging_mode.description: abap: user (when omitted) catches every request of the request user; terminal catches the requests that carry this debug state's terminal_id and ide_id. The first abap call of a debug state fixes it.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

kind.description: abap works with the ABAP debugger; amdp with the AMDP debugger of SQLScript methods.

operation.description: The one request: abap setBreakpoints, syncBreakpoints, deleteBreakpoint, createWatchpoint, listWatchpoints or deleteWatchpoint; amdp syncBreakpoints.

request_user.description: abap, user mode: the SAP user whose requests the breakpoints and the listener catch; the connected SAP user when omitted. The first abap call of a debug state fixes it.

state_handle.description: The handle of this server's debug state. abap setBreakpoints and syncBreakpoints open the debug state when it is omitted and answer its handle; every other operation takes it.

sync_objects.description: abap syncBreakpoints with sync_scope partial: the ADT URIs of the objects whose breakpoints are replaced.

sync_scope.description: abap syncBreakpoints: full replaces every breakpoint of the set; partial replaces those of the objects in sync_objects and takes line breakpoints.

watchpoint_id.description: abap deleteWatchpoint: the id SAP gave the watchpoint.

name: HandlerDebugBreakpoints
